# Argelee

> Marketing landing page for Argelee. Static, prerendered, available in Spanish and English.

Argelee's site is a single landing page served as static HTML. Spanish is the default
language and lives at the root; English lives under /en. Both are fully prerendered, so
the complete content is present in the initial HTML response without executing JavaScript.

## Pages

- [Argelee (Español)](https://argelee.com/): Landing page, Spanish.
- [Argelee (English)](https://argelee.com/en): Landing page, English.

## Notes

- Canonical URLs and reciprocal hreflang annotations are published on every page.
- Structured data (Organization, WebSite, WebPage) is embedded as JSON-LD.
- There is no API and no user-generated content.
